data.body_html:
October 2045 in Marbella delivers the best of both worlds: warm Mediterranean waters and quieter anchorages, all at shoulder-season prices. With sea temperatures between 20°C and 25°C, mild 10-15 knot winds, and fewer tourists, it’s the ideal time for a October boat rental Marbella 2045 shoulder season escape from Puerto Banús. Whether you want a 2-hour sunset cruise on an Azimut 39 (€749/2h) or a half-day adventure on a Mangusta 80 with a free jet ski, October offers availability and value that summer can’t match.

Why Choose October 2045 for Your Marbella Boat Rental?

October is the sweet spot of the Costa del Sol calendar. The scorching 35°C heat of July and August gives way to comfortable 25°C highs, while the sea retains its warmth from the summer sun. You’ll share the coastline with far fewer boats, meaning more space at Cala del Faro, Cala Cortés, and the coves near Cabopino. Plus, your budget stretches further: Tier A boats like the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 start at €749 for 2 hours, all inclusive. For a premium experience, the Mangusta 80 (Tier B) from €4,719 for 4 hours includes a jet ski — perfect for exploring hidden beaches.

October Weather & Sea Conditions in Marbella

In October 2045, expect average daytime highs of 25°C and lows of 18°C. Sea temperatures hover around 22°C, comfortable for swimming until late afternoon. Rainfall is minimal — typically 6-8 days of short showers. Wind speeds average 10-15 knots, creating stable cruising conditions for all our boats, from the compact Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) to the majestic Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax). The sun rises around 07:30 and sets around 19:30, giving you over 12 hours of daylight for a full-day charter.

Best Boats for October Charters from Puerto Banús

Our entire fleet departs from Puerto Banús. For small groups, the Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) or Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) offer nimble exploration. For families or friends, the Azimut 39 (11 pax) or Astondoa 40 (9 pax) are Tier A value picks. If you want luxury and speed, the Mangusta 80 (white or grey, 24m, 12 pax) includes a free jet ski. Larger groups can book the Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax) or Maiora 26m (12 pax) — pricing on request via WhatsApp. All charters include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance.

Top October Anchorages & Routes

With calm seas and warm sun, October is perfect for exploring the Costa del Sol’s best spots. From Puerto Banús, head west to Estepona (30 min) or Sotogrande (1 hour). Eastbound, Cabo Pino and Cala del Faro offer quiet coves for swimming. For a longer day, cruise to Gibraltar (2.5 hours). Your skipper will tailor the route to your preferences — whether that’s sunbathing, snorkelling, or lunch at a beachfront chiringuito.

What’s Included in Every Charter

  • Licensed, English-speaking skipper
  • Fuel for the entire trip
  • Bottled water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (olives, crisps, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%) — no tax surprises

Just bring swimwear, sunscreen, a towel, and your camera. We handle the rest.

Booking Tips for October 2045

October is shoulder season, but weekends still fill up. We recommend booking at least 72 hours in advance, especially for Tier B boats like the Mangusta 80. For Tier A boats, you can book online directly. For all other vessels, contact us via WhatsApp for availability and a custom quote. Consider a 4-hour charter (€749 Tier A) for a relaxed afternoon, or an 8-hour charter (€2,299 Tier A) for a full-day adventure to Sotogrande.
